## Vocabulary

- **self**: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries (32/1)

## How it works

- [statement] Writer-vector dispatch scans the original batch in order, skips entries at or before beginApplyingOpTime, and preprocesses each remaining original entry before deriving session-update operations. Validator preprocessing records a no-op only when its msg equals kWatermarkMsg; For non-no-op entries, it queues entries recognized as checkpoint applyOps. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_dispatch.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] recordWatermark requires its timestamp to exceed the newest queued cutoff, moves previous-batch ongoing deltas into a new interval, and resets ongoing. merge routes each worker record to the first cutoff greater than or equal to its timestamp; equal timestamp triggers an invariant. Records beyond every cutoff accumulate in ongoing for a later batch. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] After processing a checkpoint with a matching watermark, mergeAndValidate adds every interval through that cutoff into the baseline and removes those intervals, including watermarks without their own checkpoint. It clears the batch checkpoint list after processing. These baseline and eviction steps are outside the parameter-controlled comparison branch and therefore also occur when that parameter is false. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] A checkpoint is classified only when it is a nonempty command applyOps whose first operation names the fast-count metadata or timestamp container and whose operations include writes to both containers. Once the first operation qualifies, every inner operation must have a container; deleting from the timestamp container triggers its assertion. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] The header describes checkpoint metadata as size, count, and hash, and parseCheckpoint stores hash values, but validateCheckpoint compares only sizeCount when both entries are active. Consequently this pinned checkpoint comparison establishes neither hash equality nor complete document integrity. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.h · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The separate enableContinuousInternodePerCollectionValidation parameter is an atomic boolean settable at startup and runtime, with default false in this pinned source. mergeAndValidate calls the fatal comparison and increments the validated-checkpoint counter only when that parameter is true. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/repl_server_parameters.idl · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The equality invariant is enforced when merge assigns a current buffer record to an existing interval. The cross-batch unit fixture first merges a delta with no watermark, then records a watermark at that delta timestamp in a later batch and expects success; moving the ongoing map in recordWatermark does not re-run the timestamp check. Do not restate the current-buffer invariant as a universal cross-batch rejection. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp
- [statement] The standalone comparison helper supports fatal termination on the first mismatch or logging each mismatch and continuing. The mergeAndValidate call uses only the fatal strategy when enabled; when the parameter is off it does not call the comparison helper or automatically log mismatch errors. Its later informational checkpoint log remains outside that branch. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.h · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The actual-applier fixture asserts success for deliberately mismatched checkpoint metadata when the parameter is false and for checkpoints without matching watermarks when it is true. With validation enabled, its death tests expect fatal errors for missing UUIDs on either side and for CRUD size/count or grouped-insert size mismatches. These are declared fixture expectations. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/oplog_applier_checkpoint_validation_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] When the validation parameter is off, mergeAndValidate still merges records, computes matched checkpoints and advances/evicts their intervals, but skips validateCheckpoint and the validated counter increment. It does not fall back to error-only comparison; its later generic checkpoint log remains outside the parameter condition. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/repl_server_parameters.idl
- [statement] Each worker installs its own buffer through ScopedThreadBuffer while applying its writer batch. recordDelta does nothing without an installed buffer; the scope destructor clears the thread-local pointer. The classic applier waits for workers and returns any worker error before merging the buffers. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Before comparing, mergeAndValidate erases the oplog UUID from the primary checkpoint. The source explains that the primary derives oplog metadata while tailing rather than explicitly replicating it in the metadata field. A unit fixture supplies an oplog UUID in the checkpoint without a corresponding observed collection delta and expects success. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.h
- [statement] The report helper fasserts for kFassert and logs an error for the other strategy. The helper contract specifies immediate termination at the first inequality versus logging each inequality and continuing. The active mergeAndValidate comparison invokes kFassert only when the validation parameter is enabled. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.h

## Facts and statements

- [statement] At the pinned implementation, classic-applier preprocessing and validator-buffer allocation require secondary application mode and isContinuousInternodeValidationPerDocumentEnabled. That helper requires a replica set, then accepts either the persistence provider request or the FCV-aware per-document feature flag. The separate per-collection validation parameter is not this allocation gate. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/internode_validation_hash_utils.cpp
- [statement] At the pinned commit, per-document validation enablement first requires a replica set, then accepts either the persistence provider requirement or the FCV-aware per-document feature flag. Per-collection enablement similarly requires a replica set and accepts the provider requirement; its flag path requires both per-document and per-collection flags against one FCV snapshot. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/internode_validation_hash_utils.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl.cpp
- [statement] The pinned enableContinuousInternodePerCollectionValidation parameter is settable at startup and runtime, defaults to false, and declares that false runs no validation. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/repl_server_parameters.idl · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] The batch allocates optional per-worker buffers before filling writer vectors. Each scheduled worker installs its own buffer through ScopedThreadBuffer while applying operations. The applier waits for workers, checks statuses, and only then merges and validates using the oplog UUID. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/repl/oplog_applier_impl.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] recordDelta silently returns without a thread-local buffer; otherwise it appends timestamp, UUID and delta. ScopedThreadBuffer installs its supplied pointer and resets the thread-local pointer to nullptr on destruction. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] mergeAndValidate obtains the checkpoint cutoff from its timestamp-store valid-as-of value and requires an interval with exactly that cutoff; it does not use the checkpoint entry timestamp as the cutoff. A checkpoint without a recorded matching watermark is skipped before parsing, comparison, or baseline advancement for that entry. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/oplog_applier_checkpoint_validation_test.cpp
- [statement] computeExpectedCheckpoint sums all queued interval deltas through the matching valid-as-of cutoff, requires the last included cutoff to match exactly, and adds each changed UUID to its cumulative baseline. It returns only UUIDs observed in those intervals, so baseline-only UUIDs are absent from the expected checkpoint. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] Split or chained checkpoints are outside this validator contract: the parser header retains a chained-applyOps TODO, and the classifier does not assemble fragments. The split-flush fixture limits operations per oplog entry to one, asserts two applyOps entries, asserts neither is classified, and conditionally checks that the validated-checkpoint counter is zero. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.h · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp
- [statement] parseCheckpoint ignores inner operations outside the metadata store. A metadata container delete maps its key-derived UUID to no value; insert and update decode stored size, count and optional hash. An insert without a value raises massert 13647900. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] validateCheckpoint checks both UUID-set directions, distinguishes active from dropped optional metadata, and compares sizeCount for UUIDs active in both maps. Its report codes distinguish an unobserved primary write, an unobserved primary removal, conflicting dropped state in either direction, a size/count mismatch, and a standby UUID missing from the primary checkpoint. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp
- [statement] Parsing dropped checkpoint entries does not imply support for folding DDL deltas: foldRecord requires DDLState::kNone and invariants with the message Checkpoint validation does not support DDL deltas yet. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] The validator unit fixture directly preprocesses supplied entries, records supplied deltas in a scoped buffer, and calls mergeAndValidate. Its source asserts cross-batch carryover, cumulative checkpoints, cutoff exclusion, oplog exclusion, parameter-dependent counters, wrong-size/count fatal behavior and timestamp invariants. These are source assertions, not evidence that this research ran the tests. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The actual-applier fixture creates internal stores and constructs OplogApplierImpl in secondary mode. Its positive tests assert CRUD-delta validation, grouped inserts separated by a watermark using one worker, cumulative checkpoints, missing-watermark skipping and successful application with the validation parameter off. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/oplog_applier_checkpoint_validation_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] The actual-applier death-test source expects 13626001 for an unobserved primary entry, 13626006 for a missing primary entry, and 13626005 for CRUD size/count or grouped-insert size mismatch. These expectations describe fixture code; they do not attest test execution here. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/oplog_applier_checkpoint_validation_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The merge path rejects a delta whose timestamp equals the selected watermark cutoff, and foldRecord rejects any delta whose DDL state is not kNone. The unit death-test source separately asserts duplicate-watermark and delta-at-watermark failures; these assertions describe source fixtures, not executed results. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp
- [statement] The unit fixture directly feeds ValidatorDeltaRecord values through a scoped buffer and calls mergeAndValidate. Its source assertions cover ongoing deltas across batches, cumulative checkpoints, a later checkpoint covering multiple watermarks, and excluding deltas beyond the newest watermark; these are unit-level algorithm assertions. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The parsing fixtures write through the checkpoint flusher and read actual resulting oplog entries. Their assertions classify a checkpoint separately from user writes, user applyOps and watermarks, and parse inserted, updated and deleted metadata including optional hash presence. The assertions validate the parser surface, not the validator fold path for DDL. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/size_count_checkpoint_validator.cpp
- [statement] The actual-applier fixture creates both internal containers and constructs an OplogApplierImpl in secondary mode whose helper invokes oplogApplier.applyOplogBatch. Its CRUD test supplies insert, delete and update oplog operations with metadata and asserts success against the resulting size/count checkpoint; this is an assertion in fixture source, not a test execution claim. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/e37ae17db503703515d2ec35f6793dee7651655f/src/mongo/db/replicated_fast_count/oplog_applier_checkpoint_validation_test.cpp · keywords: Pinned classic-applier replicated-metadata checkpoint validation boundaries
- [statement] The actual-applier grouped-insert fixture uses one worker and places another insert between the watermark and its later checkpoint entry; it asserts success against only the pre-watermark inserts. A separate actual-applier fixture asserts cumulative totals for two successive checkpoints, and another leaves a later watermark without a checkpoint.
